articles.title: Orcas Play Food-Smashing Game with Giant Sunfish!
articles.summary: Imagine a 2,000-kg fish getting smashed into thousands of pieces by two orcas working together. Scientists in the Gulf of California filmed this never-before-seen behavior for the first time. It might be how adults help kids eat—or just for fun!

articles.title: Kidneys Kept Super-Cold for Days Work Perfectly in Pigs!
articles.summary: Scientists cooled pig kidneys to -4°C without freezing them, stored them for three days, and transplanted them back. The kidneys worked faster than those kept on ice. This could help solve the organ shortage—over 104,000 people in the US are waiting for a kidney.

articles.title: Mystery Bacteria Found in Super-Shy Deep-Sea Whales!
articles.summary: Scientists discovered three new types of bacteria in pygmy sperm whales that washed ashore. These tiny creatures, called Helicobacter, were linked to stomach ulcers. It's the first time they've been found in these elusive whales—and there might be many more unknown ocean bacteria!
